answer.value: RPG scores show relatively consistent performance across most platforms, with a narrow range from 6.05 (Nintendo 64) to 8.29 (Xbox One). Xbox platforms tend to have slightly higher scores (Xbox: 8.28, Xbox 360: 7.65, Xbox One: 8.29) while Nintendo platforms show more variation (Nintendo 64: 6.05, Game Boy Color: 7.29, Nintendo DSi: 7.17). PlayStation platforms maintain consistent scores around 7.4-7.9 range. The overall average across all platforms is 7.54, indicating generally positive RPG reviews with minimal platform bias.
